title: Unlock the Temple Woods Vault Hidden Chamber in Runescape Dragon Wilds
author: Mature Minded Gamers
description: RuneScape Dragon Wilds Temple Woods Vault. We will show how to access the secret room. #RuneScape #DragonWilds #TipsAndTricks #Gaming #MMG #Tutorial #Gamer #Gameplay #Walkthrough #Adventure

transcript.text: Hey everybody, Eric here. Welcome to the channel. We're talking Ruinscape Dragon Wilds. If you're running through the
first dungeon here and you're stuck at the one here in Temple Woods at that final room, you can't get in there. You
can see it, but none of the levers open the door. Let me show you right now how to get in there. So, right here at the
end of the dungeon in that big room that's kind of wide open, has the different directions you can go. If you
look up, there's a hole up there. And you can use your teleports magic ability here, your levitate or wind step to get
yourself up there. And once you're in there, you just run straight through. Now, my buddy Bowden here already hit
the lever to open the gate, but that's where the gate was there on the other side. And you can access the treasure
chest and get all the loot. And then that will hopefully complete this dungeon for you. Thanks for watching
everybody. Don't forget to give us a thumbs up and make sure you subscribe. Otherwise, we're not going to be able to
